4h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v4"></path><path d="M21 14H11"></path><path d="m15 10-4 4 4 4"></path></svg></span><span>复制全文</span></button></div><h1 class="group min-w-0 text-4xl font-medium leading-tight mb-8 text-foreground" id="bot-channel">Bot Channel<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h1>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">Bot Channel 用来把外部聊天工具接入 ZCode。配置完成后，你可以从微信或飞书会话里打开当前工作区，查看任务进度，并继续给 Agent 发送指令。</p>
<img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/bc-overview-card-20260612.webp" alt="Bot Channel 总览：机器人管理与各渠道入口" style="max-width:100%"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="create-bot-channel">新建 Bot Channel<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">打开 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">移动端远程控制</strong> 弹窗，右侧就是 Bot Channel 入口：点击对应聊天工具开始接入，或进入底部 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">机器人管理</strong> 查看已有机器人。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/bc-entry-dialog-20260612.webp" alt="移动端远程控制弹窗右侧的 Bot Channel 入口" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">目前可创建的渠道包括：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">微信</strong>：扫码登录，自动绑定。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">飞书</strong>：扫码创建应用，再通过消息绑定。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">钉钉、Discord 和企业微信会在后续版本继续补齐。</p>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="wechat-pairing">微信配对流程<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">微信的接入最简单：在机器人页选择 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">微信</strong>，用手机微信扫码并确认连接，凭据会自动保存。绑定完成后，直接在微信里和这个 Bot 对话即可。</p>
<img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/bc-wechat-flow-card-20260612.webp" alt="微信配对流程：桌面扫码、手机确认、绑定后对话" style="max-width:100%"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="feishu-pairing">飞书配对流程<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">飞书分两步。第一步创建应用：在 ZCode 里选择 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">飞书</strong> 并扫码，手机上会打开飞书开放平台，确认智能体应用的名称和头像后点击 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">立即创建</strong>，等待配置完成。</p>
<img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/bc-feishu-create-card-20260612.webp" alt="飞书创建应用：桌面扫码、手机确认、创建成功" style="max-width:100%"/>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">第二步绑定会话：ZCode 会生成一段限时有效的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">绑定命令</strong>（形如 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">/bind C67356</code>），在飞书里向这个智能体发送该命令，机器人回复绑定成功并列出全部可用命令。</p>
<img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/bc-feishu-bind-card-20260613-cn.webp" alt="飞书绑定：桌面生成 /bind 命令，飞书里发送完成绑定" style="max-width:100%"/>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">绑定成功后，飞书 Bot 会返回可用命令。常用命令包括查看状态、新建任务、切换项目、切换模型、切换运行模式和调整回复详细度。后续你可以直接在飞书里向 ZCode Agent 发消息，适合在手机上持续跟进长任务。</p>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="manage-bots">管理机器人<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">创建后，机器人会出现在左侧列表中。这里可以启用或停用机器人、查看连通状态、设置回复颗粒度，并限制它可以访问的 workspace。</p>
<img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/bc-manage-card-20260612.webp" alt="机器人管理：连通状态、回复颗粒度与工作区访问范围" style="max-width:100%"/>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">常用配置包括：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">关联机器人</strong>：扫码或按界面提示完成凭据绑定，已连通的机器人可随时 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">解绑</strong>。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">机器人回复颗粒度</strong>：控制机器人回复的详细程度。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">工作区访问范围</strong>：限制机器人可打开的工作区。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">删除机器人</strong>：移除不再使用的渠道。</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="feishu-streaming-card">飞书的流式卡片回复<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">飞书和 Lark 渠道统一使用 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">流式卡片</strong> 回复，没有颗粒度选项（标准、完整、摘要这几档只对其他渠道生效）。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">它的实际效果是：Agent 的回答不再拆成一条条消息刷屏，而是 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">在同一张卡片里原地更新</strong>，你能看着它一点点写完。卡片内容按时间顺序穿插正文和工具调用，工具部分只显示折叠起来的摘要，展开才看细节，不会把原始输出糊在聊天里。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">当 Agent 需要你做决定时（选择方案、授权某个操作、确认计划），当前卡片会先定格保留，用一张单独的卡片来问你；你答复之后，后续输出会开一张新卡片继续。</p>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="chat-entry">从聊天工具进入工作区<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">Bot Channel 配置完成后，就可以在聊天工具中向机器人发送消息。机器人会把请求转给 ZCode Agent，并返回任务进度或工作区入口。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/zcode-docs-20260612-bot-channel-remote-task.webp" alt="Bot Channel 远程继续任务" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/bc-chat-entry-card-20260612.webp" alt="微信与飞书里与 ZCode Bot 对话" style="max-width:100%"/>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">这种方式适合在手机上长期跟进任务：你可以在微信或飞书里继续发消息，必要时再打开工作区查看完整会话。</p>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="remote-vs-bot-channel">用扫码还是用 Bot<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">离开电脑后继续推进任务有两条路，差别在入口形式：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Bot Channel</strong>：入口常驻在微信或飞书的会话里，适合长期反复回访同一个工作区。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground"><a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/remote-control">Remote Control</a></strong>：手机扫码，用完即走，适合临时看一眼。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">两者操作的都是桌面端已有的会话，代码仍然跑在桌面端原本连着的那个环境里。如果你要改变的是代码运行的位置，那属于 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/remote-development">远程开发</a>。</p>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="next-steps">下一步<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
